text: I don't give trade instructions or sizes; any size suggestion comes only from the sizing assistant in paper risk units, and the decision stays with you. What the files show: on release days WTI has moved -0.3481% per 1 sd crude-stock surprise since 2001 (-0.223% since 2015), a same-day association that predicts nothing ahead of the report. The next WPSR is due 2026-10-28.
